drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 58-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.66, creatinine 2.08-2.14, hemoglobin 13.5, platelets 261-264, sodium 139, wbc 6.1-6.4; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 85-91, map 85-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 126-131, spo2 96-98, temp 37.1-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.14-2.15, hemoglobin 13.6, platelets 264-270, sodium 139, wbc 5.8-6.5; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 86-90, map 84-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 123-130, spo2 96-98, temp 37-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 58-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
